title: FX30 6.01: rear screen shows the open-gate live view at 3:2 (16:9 letterbox ratio 9/16 -> 2/3, frame widgets' 16:9 entries for both panel shapes), and the built-in De-Squeeze Display ratios set for a 3:2 picture (1.3x 1.95:1, 1.5x 2.25:1, 1.6x (1.65) 2.475:1, 2.0x the whole frame at 3:1 with the centre 4:3 crop off)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 6.01 (ILME-FX30), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only
ported_from: lcd32dsq_fx3_v1 (FX3 7.02; its screen part works on two FX3s, 2026-11-24): the FX30's VDF code is the FX3's relocated, so the 30 words are the FX3 design's words at the ported addresses (asserted twin by twin), with the FX3's 32 guards ported (the four crop guards start 2 bytes later: the crop block moved by 0x68bd6)

summary.panel: rear LCD 2,359,296 dots (Sony) = 1024 x 768: 4:3, panel code 0 from type byte 2 expected (type byte RAM 0x16295d4); the design also gives the right picture if the byte says 3 (3:2)
summary.picture: 16:9 live view (aspect code 2) holding the whole 3:2 sensor area
goes_with: the FX30 open-gate state (sensor, output-size and encoder steps of fx30_601)

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the rear screen is shown at 3:2 and the de-squeeze ratios are those of a 3:2 picture (other movie formats look wrong there). 2.0x's ratio is the calculator's default for every picture shape and its crop is off for every shape, so 2.0x shows any picture at 3:1 (the open-gate live view is always 16:9). HDMI's own layout and the 17:9 ratios of 1.3x / 1.5x / 1.6x are unchanged
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an FX30
the FX30's rear panel type byte 0x16295d4 (expected 2 = 4:3 from Sony's 2,359,296 dots = 1024 x 768; a dump should read it)
that the FX30's menu sends codes 1 to 4 for 1.3x, 1.5x, 1.6x and 2.0x (inferred from the calculator's ratios, as on the FX3)
whether the focus frames are drawn while de-squeeze is on (the frame check has no de-squeeze input; stock behaves the same)
